item.title: Delta Therapeutics Receives FDA Approval for DLX-101 in Rare Pediatric Epilepsy
item.description: BOSTON, Sept. 25, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Delta Therapeutics, Inc. (NASDAQ: DLTX) today announced that the U.S. Food and Drug Administration has approved DLX-101 — the company’s first product — for the treatment of a rare pediatric epilepsy.

item.title: Echo Mining Signs Letter of Intent to Explore Potential Lithium Partnership
item.description: VANCOUVER, BC, Sept. 25, 2026 /PRNewswire/ - Echo Mining Corp. (TSXV: ECM) (OTCQB: ECMGF) is thrilled to announce a non-binding letter of intent that could potentially lead to a game-changing partnership in a $50 billion market.
